comment: Level 5. Read by BOTH the game (controlquest/gameplay/level_data.py) and the engine (engine_server/level_rules/common.py). Calibrated with engine_server/calibrate.py.

knobs.name: k
knobs.label: Re-plan interval
knobs.help: Solve the OCP only every k samples (k·Δt seconds); in between, apply the next inputs of the last plan open-loop. Every solve costs one unit of the compute budget.

knobs.name: margin
knobs.label: Obstacle margin
knobs.help: Added to every semi-axis of the obstacle ellipses [m]: room for the wind to push the ball off its plan.
